transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I know my paintings have an important message for the people running this country, and no one seems to understand that. My wife got really worried about how much I've been focusing on them, so she persuaded me to come in and talk to you.
Have you been experiencing an unusually high level of energy, or have you found that you need much less sleep than usual lately?

Yes, I have this intense, restless energy that keeps me on my feet all day, doing things like reorganizing the basement and painting canvas after canvas. I've been staying up incredibly late working on my art projects because my mind is racing and I have this strong drive to keep going. Sleeping just feels like a complete waste of time right now when there is so much to do.
Have you ever experienced a significant period of time in the past where you felt deeply depressed, hopeless, or lost interest in things you usually enjoy?

No, I haven't really ever felt deeply depressed or hopeless like that in the past. I don't recall ever going through a time where I lost interest in things, as I've usually been able to just keep going.
Do you believe that you have a special connection to influential people or that you have been chosen to play a unique role in society that others cannot see?

Yes, I do. I am convinced that the colors and shapes in my paintings contain hidden messages meant specifically for the President and other national leaders to see. I feel this profound responsibility, like it's my job to save our town's soul, even though my wife and others think it's far-fetched and don't understand.

Do you feel that your belief about having a special role and the messages in your paintings is directly linked to your current high energy and excitement, or do these thoughts persist even when you are not feeling particularly energetic?

Yes, they are definitely linked to this high energy. I never had these ideas about my paintings holding secret messages before I got so wound up and driven a couple of months ago. On the rare days when my energy dips back toward normal, those thoughts seem to fade into the background.
Have you recently used any medications, supplements, or substances, or have you been diagnosed with any new medical conditions around the time these symptoms began?
No, I haven't started taking any new medications, supplements, or other substances recently. I also haven't been diagnosed with any new medical conditions.

Have you ever had any other periods in your life, perhaps lasting several days or more, where you felt unusually energetic, restless, or driven, even if it didn't involve these specific thoughts about your paintings?

No, I don't recall ever feeling this way before in my life. This intense energy and drive is completely new to me, and it only started about two months ago. Before this, my life was much more quiet and normal.
